prompt: A car uses $12$ gallons to drive $360$ miles. Find **miles per gallon**.
hint: Miles per gallon measures how far one gallon takes the car. Put the miles first when you set up the division.

hints.text: Miles per gallon measures how far one gallon takes the car. Put the miles first when you set up the division.
Divide the $360$ miles by the $12$ gallons. Knowing that $36 \div 12 = 3$ makes this quick.
$360 \div 12 = 30$, so the car gets $30$ miles per gallon.

explanation: The rate "miles per gallon" means miles divided by gallons.
Set up the division with the numbers given: $360 \div 12$.
Since $36 \div 12 = 3$, making the top ten times bigger gives $360 \div 12 = 30$.
The car travels $30$ miles on each gallon.
